$comment: Agent I/O contracts for the Northstar Insight Copilot. Each agent's output is validated against its schema before handoff; a validation failure is treated as verifier:fail, never silently passed forward.

category.$comment: Collapsed from 6 categories to 4 in Sprint 2, based on empirical Router evaluation: simple_lookup/aggregation/trend all route to the identical downstream chain (see architecture.md sec 1), so the finer distinction added classification failure surface with zero operational benefit. See orchestration_decision_record.md addendum for the full finding.

sql.description: must start with SELECT; enforced again at sandbox layer, not trusted from the model alone

assumptions_stated.description: e.g. 'filtered to order_status=delivered', 'used COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) due to multi-item orders'

schema_lookup_refs.description: which schema/semantic-layer lookups this query was grounded against

verifier_output.$comment: execution_sql is INTERNAL ONLY - never serialized to any downstream agent's context or the user response. display_sql is the only SQL representation allowed to leave this agent, generated by AST reconstruction against an identifier allowlist, not by string-redacting execution_sql. See docs/stage3_design/agent_contract_result_verifier.md for the full rationale.

display_sql.description: AST-reconstructed, allowlist-only identifiers - the only SQL representation ever passed to the Narrator or shown to a user

sample_rows.description: capped at N rows, values only, no internal metadata

narrator_output.$comment: Narrator receives only verifier_output.display_sql - it never has access to execution_sql and therefore cannot leak it even by mistake.

answer_text.description: every number must trace to a value in verifier_output.result_summary

sql_shown.description: must equal verifier_output.display_sql verbatim - the Narrator does not regenerate or modify the query text
